liam: Kicking off a conservative ramp for feature flag `ml_route_v5` in the 01:45 UTC change window. plan: 0% -> 1% -> 5% -> 25% (10m gates). Model pin: v5.0.0 for exposures; fallback v4.9.7.
deploybot: scheduled: 2024-06-10T01:45:00Z job queued (id 20240610-llmroute-5). will post step events.
sara: rollback triggers proposed: immediate drain on p95 > 300ms OR 5xx jump > 0.7% for 3m. also rollback on auto-quality-eval fail.
oncall-bot: monitors set: latency_p95, 5xx_rate, token_loss_rate. page on sev1 if p95 > 550ms or 5xx_rate > 2% for 2m. runbook: https://wiki/internal/ff-guides#ml_route_v5
tia: adding to release notes: "ml_route_v5 staged roll with soft-pin v5.0.0; autoswap to v4.9.7 on errors." linking doc. :memo:
liam: ops checklist:
- t+0: set ml_route_v5 = 1% and enable soft-pin v5.0.0 for 8m
- wait 10m, run smoke prompts, check p95/5xx/token_loss
- t+10: bump to 5% if green; repeat to 25%
- fast-disable: `releases flag disable ml_route_v5 --now`
sara: smoke run #1: p95 +9ms, 5xx unchanged, small token_loss signal +0.1%. quality checks pass. green to proceed.
deploybot: step1 executed: ml_route_v5 = 1% (6966667800). next bump scheduled at +10m.
tia: noted. I'll stay on-call for the window. if any oddity, we fast-disable.
liam: proceeding to 5% now. calling it out before action.
deploybot: step2 executed: ml_route_v5 = 5% (6966668400). next bump planned at +10m.
sara: seeing a tiny uptick in kv cache miss (+0.5%). keeping watch; not tripping rollback yet.
liam: hold before 25% for an extra 10m to validate cache behavior. will update release notes.
